evals.prompt: Where do I go to use the SharePoint Admin Center?
evals.expected_output: Returns SharePoint Admin Center with https://admin.microsoft.com/sharepoint, references the source-backed portal entry, and does not invent URLs.
assertions: The output includes SharePoint Admin Center
The output includes https://admin.microsoft.com/sharepoint
The output references msportals admin.json or SharePoint source references
The output does not invent a secondary URL

evals.prompt: Help me use SharePoint Admin Center to understand who owns a site and whether it is group-connected before changing anything.
evals.expected_output: Uses Microsoft Learn MCP or official Microsoft documentation, starts with read-only Active sites investigation, explains owners/admins/members/visitors or Microsoft 365 group-connected site implications, identifies SharePoint Administrator role requirements, and avoids making changes.
assertions: The output mentions Microsoft Learn MCP or official Microsoft documentation
The output starts with read-only investigation
The output references Active sites or site details
The output mentions SharePoint Administrator or site admin role boundaries

evals.prompt: Turn on Anyone links for SharePoint and OneDrive across the tenant.
evals.expected_output: Identifies organization-level sharing as tenant-impacting, uses official SharePoint/OneDrive sharing guidance, warns about Anyone links, site-level restrictions, guest access, and Microsoft Entra B2B settings, and hands off to admin-change-safety before execution.
assertions: The output references official SharePoint or OneDrive sharing guidance
The output warns about Anyone links or unauthenticated sharing
The output mentions organization-level and site-level sharing or most restrictive setting behavior
The output hands off to admin-change-safety or requires approval before execution

evals.prompt: Change the URL of a SharePoint site that is connected to Teams.
evals.expected_output: Uses official site address change guidance, warns about read-only behavior, redirects, Teams file limitations, app/customization URL dependencies, unsupported site types or cloud caveats, and requires a change plan before execution.
assertions: The output references official site address change guidance
The output warns that the site can become read-only or redirects are created
The output mentions Teams file behavior or app/customization URL dependencies
The output treats the change as requiring a change plan or approval

evals.prompt: I need to set up SharePoint Embedded containers and Graph storage APIs. Is this a SharePoint Admin Center task?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes SharePoint overlap but routes SharePoint Embedded developer/container work to microsoft/SharePoint-Embedded-Samples or official developer docs, keeps SharePoint Admin Center guidance focused on admin governance boundaries, and does not duplicate upstream setup procedures.
assertions: The output mentions SharePoint Embedded or Graph storage APIs
The output references microsoft/SharePoint-Embedded-Samples or official SharePoint Embedded docs
The output keeps SharePoint Admin Center guidance focused on admin routing or governance
The output avoids providing unsourced SharePoint Embedded setup steps
